cases.name: source_reload
cases.reason: An edit changes the serving process and response at the same address while preserving committed data.

cases.name: source_failure
cases.reason: GoDj prepares a compiled candidate before replacing its last working application; Django's replacement child imports the edited Python source.

cases.name: field_change
cases.reason: Explicit migration preserves the old row with a null added field and permits a value on a new row.

cases.name: no_reload
cases.reason: An explicit single-run server keeps its loaded code until restart.

cases.name: explicit_restart
cases.reason: A fresh process reads edited code and previously committed values.

cases.name: session_relation
cases.reason: The same authenticated client retains access to committed domain data and group membership across a source reload.

cases.name: current_permission
cases.reason: Each new request observes revocation and restoration of the current group grant, including after reload.

cases.name: csrf
cases.reason: An authenticated unsafe request without a CSRF token is rejected.

cases.name: command_failure
cases.reason: A command error after a confirmed save does not roll back that earlier save.
